careerDirection.directionDescription: E-commerce marketing involves driving traffic, conversion, and repeat purchase on online retail platforms. D2C marketing managers run owned-channel acquisition programmes; marketplace analysts optimise product listings; growth hackers find low-cost customer acquisition channels. BBA Digital Marketing graduates understand the digital funnel, product listing optimisation, and customer lifecycle management that are central to e-commerce marketing.

careerDirection.directionDescription: Brand management involves building and protecting brand identity across digital and traditional channels. Brand executives execute brand guidelines; campaign managers plan and run marketing campaigns; brand communications executives produce consistent messaging across touchpoints. BBA Digital Marketing graduates who develop brand strategy skills alongside their digital tool proficiency are well suited for brand management roles.

careerDirection.directionDescription: Performance marketing involves managing paid acquisition campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Meta, and programmatic platforms. Performance marketing analysts monitor campaign KPIs, optimise ad spend, and improve cost-per-acquisition. BBA Digital Marketing is one of the few undergraduate programmes that teaches campaign management, digital advertising platforms, and conversion analytics as core subjects — making this the most direct career outcome.
